name: AgentCollect
long_description:
We recover aged B2B debt in weeks, not quarters: ~49% in 20 days vs ~20% in 4-6 months for traditional agencies.
Our AI agents call, email, text, find the right contact (20% of B2B contact data is outdated), and negotiate payment plans 24/7 ; all under your brand. 
We replace your offshore BPO and third-party agencies. 
Your AR team stays focused on strategic accounts.

Live with Dell, Microsoft, FedEx, Plaid, and Checkr and hundreds of enterprise companies.

Long-tail AR your team has deprioritized becomes recovered cash before a traditional agency even gets moving.

question_answers.question: How did your company get started? (i.e., How did the founders meet? How did you come up with the idea? How did you decide to be a founder?)
question_answers.answer:
My grandfather ran a furniture store in France. He extended credit himself, on trust. When customers didn't pay, he knocked on their doors on Sundays. One day, a customer pulled a knife on him.

I grew up hearing that story. Then I started a business and ran into the same wall: customers who don't pay. The impossible choice: push too hard, they turn on you; push too soft, they ignore you.

That was collections before software. The problem is still the same.

Every B2B invoice is a loan. Every company extends credit. But when customers pay late, they still hand the problem to legacy collections agencies that recover \~20% in 4-6 months and damage the brand on the way out.

I built AgentCollect because no one should knock on doors anymore. AI agents call, email, and negotiate 24/7 under our customer's brand. We recover \~49% in 20 days. Live with Dell, Microsoft, FedEx, Plaid, and Checkr.

founders.title: Founder/CEO
founders.founder_bio: My prior startup's downfall was due to unpaid invoices. With no viable market solution and seeing that 1/4 of businesses faced bankruptcy for similar reasons, I founded Respaid, using AI and respect to address the issue. Beyond entrepreneurship, I'm a commander in the French Republican Guard, a pianist, composer, and passionate about fintech meeting psychology. An engineer by training, I graduated from Harvard Business School and Ecole Centrale Electronique. Also, I'm a proud dad of 4 under 5 🙂

launches.title: Respaid - Respectful B2B Collection, powered by AI
launches.tagline: "The nice guy of the debt collection industry 😇"
launches.body:
Hey! This is John, the founder of [**Respaid.com**](http://Respaid.com)

**Are you constantly juggling a million things while overdue bills keep slipping through the cracks? AI-powered respectful collection enables you to receive up to 9x more payments.**

![](https://lh4.googleusercontent.com/PTwTgW1BacUmzMAqUzhE0hyLy2tdWeb8btBW51Gl4dNEfzXOfjZchTFeCdEccjcySs6WpqBObpY9U8yaffvEjdnGhghmZJNtbEm4orexPgmNXD3bU5JNL-ZtcqFtoYWMY-HTGu0hgo--CAl1y8eW8JM)

_Yeah… I'm a solo founder, but.. I’m not alone. Actually we’re 40+ passionate people from 7 countries!_ 

### **❌ Problem: collect small overdue bills is hard**

Be too harsh and people feel offended, be too soft, and they not take it seriously.\
At Respaid, we've found the sweet spot. With our similar approach that a lawyer would do, combined with surprising softness and simple direct payments, people are happy to pay (NPS: 93).\
Your brand reputation is even greater.

### **✨ Solution: AI-Powered Lawyer collection + Respect**

We combine a respectful approach (contact with care through a real lawyer) + AI (predict the perfect timing, message and channel) to collect your overdue bills. Your customers are surprised that your company’s lawyer has been soft and made it easy to pay.\
How to start: **give us a simple excel file, we do the rest (no attached invoices required).**

![](https://lh4.googleusercontent.com/TjqFpV2BgichtCkOzQ3AEqovNqRApXbhF1o5-as9KmXvC89ix1ey_nHICLlFkptfyr2gihAjBHPNuAA6JKOPCQeVZXZBA78R7qjlWjci8C5XukHVXEWeV3mIVoGtmfyhnGGQJZytYmsNQQcObEdeKrA)

_e.g. Apple Pay increase collection rate by up to 7%_

### **👉 For Who: SaaS, Subscription and Marketplace**

Your customers are SMBs? Finding a solution which is profitable and not time consuming is now possible.\
We currently have 458 customers (DoorDash, Checkr, Podium…) in 8 industries (retail, insurance, finance, service..). We usually start with an excel file, but you can also automate us through Zapier or direct API.\
**We do up to 85k collections per day!**

![](https://lh5.googleusercontent.com/skDiOeoYmVP8Va2V20WkzD8P_ZDKgtve5JeG5jBc-u1V9-A2DMKkGVUDxNx1Tw8-FLtrG-M2yNhdq2FbN_q8G2BDSyhZBaxLnQwY5WEF5UlRxNzLnpHdbyLIANNiYPOc3wocvrFHxyUNjcQZ_mUpPvs)

### **🕤 BackStory: how BAD debts killed my last startup**

In my previous startup, I didn’t find a solution to chase small debts, and debt collectors would not take us seriously regarding volume or risk too high (they tend to select debts they have more chance to be collected). I realized 1/ 4 startups fail due to small debts. I knew the only way to fix it was through technology + respect. 18 months later, we were #1 on Trustpilot “debt collector”, had 16 unicorn customers.\
**But….we never officially launched in the US… until today!**

### **• We do a fair pricing (success fees only)**

You only pay a success fee when we succeed (starting 10.9%). In the industry, we’re probably the only ones to even display a pricing page as we understood it was not right to calculate pricing depending on debt quality.\
Use the code “_YCS23_”🔥 at signup to get 1 month trial period, there's no need to worry about license fees.\
It's our way of demonstrating our commitment to your success.

### **🙏 How You Can Help**

**Intros to founders/CFO** - You can help us by introducing startups/companies having: 1. a lot of SMBs or 2. a lot of individuals as customers to share how they handle overdue bills. Please cc me: [j+YC@respaid.com](mailto:j+YC@respaid.com) or directly [book a demo here](http://jo.respaid.com)
